recommendations.title: Healthy Weight Plan
recommendations.recommendationText: Focus on building sustainable daily habits rather than pursuing rapid weight loss. Gradual improvements are more likely to produce lasting results.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Healthy weight management is primarily achieved through consistent nutrition, regular movement, quality sleep, and behaviour change—not short-term restrictive diets.
recommendations.expectedTimeline: Visible improvements typically develop over weeks to months depending on consistency and individual circumstances.

recommendations.title: Portion Awareness
recommendations.recommendationText: Become more aware of portion sizes before changing the types of food you eat. Small reductions in portion size can meaningfully reduce excess energy intake without making meals feel restrictive.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Portion control is one of the most effective ways to manage energy balance without removing your favorite foods.
actionSteps: Eat slowly and stop when 80% full
recommendations.expectedTimeline: Immediate reduction in energy intake; results visible in 2-4 weeks.

recommendations.title: Reduce Sugary Drinks
recommendations.recommendationText: Replace sugar-sweetened beverages with water or other low- or no-added-sugar options whenever practical.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Liquid calories often do not provide satiety and can easily lead to a positive energy balance.
actionSteps: Swap one sugary drink for water daily

recommendations.title: Establish Regular Meals
recommendations.recommendationText: Develop a meal schedule that fits your lifestyle and helps reduce long gaps between eating occasions if those gaps contribute to overeating later in the day.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Irregular eating patterns can disrupt hunger hormones and lead to impulsive food choices.
actionSteps: Avoid skipping meals intentionally if it causes later hunger
recommendations.expectedTimeline: 1-2 weeks for hunger cues to stabilize.

recommendations.title: Increase Daily Movement
recommendations.recommendationText: Increase daily movement gradually. Small increases in walking, standing, and other routine activity can provide meaningful health benefits.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) makes up a significant portion of daily calorie burn.
recommendations.expectedTimeline: Immediate benefits to mood; physical changes in 4-6 weeks.

recommendations.title: Build an Exercise Routine
recommendations.recommendationText: Aim to build a regular exercise routine that is realistic for your schedule and fitness level.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Exercise preserves muscle mass during weight loss and improves overall metabolic health.
actionSteps: Focus on consistency over intensity initially
recommendations.expectedTimeline: Strength and endurance improve within weeks.

recommendations.title: Improve Sleep Recovery
recommendations.recommendationText: Improving sleep duration and sleep quality may make healthy eating, activity, and recovery easier to maintain.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Poor sleep alters hunger hormones, making cravings harder to resist and reducing energy for activity.
actionSteps: Ensure a dark, cool sleeping environment
recommendations.expectedTimeline: Immediate improvement in energy and mood within days.

recommendations.title: Stress Management
recommendations.recommendationText: Identify practical strategies that help reduce or manage daily stress, as persistent stress can affect eating behaviours, recovery, and motivation.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Chronic stress elevates cortisol which can promote fat storage and trigger emotional eating.
actionSteps: Take short mental breaks during work

recommendations.title: Emotional Eating Support
recommendations.recommendationText: Before eating, pause briefly and ask whether you are responding to physical hunger or an emotional trigger. Increasing awareness is often the first step toward changing the habit.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Separating emotions from food allows for more mindful choices.

recommendations.title: Stop Weight Cycling
recommendations.recommendationText: Rather than repeatedly starting over with restrictive plans, focus on creating routines that you can realistically maintain for months and years.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Yo-yo dieting can slow metabolism and make future weight loss more difficult.
successIndicators: Focusing on habits over the scale

recommendations.title: Set Realistic Expectations
recommendations.recommendationText: Set milestones that prioritize healthy lifestyle improvements instead of rapid weight change. Sustainable progress is generally more maintainable.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Unrealistic goals often lead to disappointment and abandoning healthy habits.
actionSteps: Focus on behaviour goals instead of scale weight

recommendations.title: Habit Coaching
recommendations.recommendationText: Start with one or two simple habits instead of trying to change everything at once. Early success often builds confidence for larger lifestyle changes.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Overhauling your entire life at once usually leads to burnout.
actionSteps: Pick one habit to focus on this week

recommendations.title: Keep Going
recommendations.recommendationText: You already have several healthy habits supporting your goal. Focus on maintaining these strengths while improving one additional area at a time.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Maintaining good habits is just as important as building new ones.

recommendations.title: Protect Your Recovery
recommendations.recommendationText: Your recovery habits appear to be a strength. Continue protecting your sleep and stress-management routines as you work toward your goals.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: A strong foundation of recovery makes all other fitness goals easier.

recommendations.title: Maintain Balanced Nutrition
recommendations.recommendationText: Your eating habits already include several positive behaviours. Continue building on this strong foundation rather than making unnecessary drastic changes.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: You don't need a perfect diet to get great results.
